Display over other apps (face cam in other apps)

The camera and microphone let the app record your face and voice. Display over other apps keeps the face cam floating above your slides, and notifications let you stop a recording from the notification shade. Allowing them here avoids interruptions in the middle of a recording.
A short countdown gives you time to switch to your slides or app before recording begins, so the start of your video isn\'t spent fumbling with controls.

Choose the microphone to record your voice along with the screen, or mute for a silent video, for example when you plan to add a voice-over or music later. Plug in a headset or USB microphone and it is used automatically; you can switch back to the phone microphone here.
After a recording finishes, the app also makes a cropped copy for each ratio you tick, so you get vertical, portrait or square versions ready to post without editing.
After recording, the app can replace the room behind you in the face cam with the sample background you pick, so your video looks tidy wherever you recorded it.
